lines.en: I walk toward you with heavy steps.
My plates knock together as I go.

lines.zh: 我沿着雾中的石道前进。
lines.en: I advance along the foggy stone path.
I step and pause, keeping balance.
I go around a broken pillar.
I level my shield before me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面扫过石面。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the stone behind me.
My scales overlap, plate on plate.
I walk from fog into the light.
I move toward your flank.
I stop and adjust my grip.
I press one step nearer.
I stand with my shield steady.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在暗处发着红光。
lines.en: My scales glow red in the dark.
I strike my shield with a fist.

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲缝隙冒着热气。
lines.en: Heat rises from the gaps in my scales.
Fog rolls past my feet.
I roll my shoulders slowly.
Fighting is what I know, not talking.
I stand still as a door slab.
I glance up at the cliff.
My tail props on the ground.
I run a hand along the shield rim.
I breathe out a plume of hot mist.
You stand before my shield.

lines.zh: 我的角几乎碰到你的额头。
lines.en: My horn nearly touches your brow.
Your weapon isn't long enough.
I raise a hand and knock the shield.
I keep this stretch of stone.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后扫了一下。
lines.en: My tail sweeps once behind me.
My armor carries many scratches.
My gaze settles by your feet.
I know this kind of standoff.
If you want through, you pass me first.
A scale cracks and heat escapes.
A scale chips off.
Half my scales have cracked.
My shield is still here.
I'm not used to retreating.
I raise the shield higher.
I've measured your strength.
I can't see you well in the fog.
This scratch is nothing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片掉下来，还是热的。
lines.en: The scales I shed are still warm.
I won't take this.
I raise my shield and look away.
Set it on the stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片烧过一次，更硬。
lines.en: My scales were burned once. Harder now.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不到我的盾。
lines.en: That won't buy my shield.
I bend and flick a glance at it.
I'm still more concerned with you.
Take it back; I won't take it.
It's at my feet; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我隔着盾缝看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I eye your offering through my shield gap.
You hit my shield.
I barely move. My scales are thick.
My shield rim hits your collarbone.
My pauldron knocks you back.
My armor covers me well.
There's a scrape on the stone.
I turn to block the passage.
That impact doesn't hurt.
I hold my footing.
I level the shield again.

lines.zh: 另一个甲影从雾里出来。
lines.en: Another armored shape comes out of the fog.
Our shields stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我们一起守住这段崖道。
lines.en: We guard this cliff path together.

lines.zh: 它的甲上有同样的刻痕。
lines.en: Its armor bears the same cuts.
We knock shields together.

lines.zh: 雾把我们的影子连起来。
lines.en: Fog joins our shadows.
Both our breathing slows.
The night is long; we don't tire.
Tomorrow we swap shifts.
Before the fog lifts, we're still here.
I bend and scoop it up in a fist.
This weight can't fill my grip.

lines.zh: 我把战利品卡在腰带里。
lines.en: I wedge the loot into my belt.
I look, then toss it aside.
It chills my gauntlet.
I pin it under my shield.
No harm in carrying this.
I sweep it into the lava with my shield.
My grip left a dent in it.
I lower my hand again.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片竖起来发出响。
lines.en: My scales rise with a rasp.
I raise my shield high.
Fine, you're the one I stop.

lines.zh: 你在我盾前的位置定了。
lines.en: Your place before my shield is fixed.
Only one can pass this stone path.
I press forward behind my shield.
There's nothing to discuss between us.

lines.zh: 鳞片护着的手，又抬起来。
lines.en: The scale-guarded hand lifts again.

lines.zh: 我的影子堵住了你的退路。
lines.en: My shadow blocks your retreat.
My shield is up at brow height.
I hold this fight.
My scales glow red. I come straight in.
Your opening is at the flank.
I press forward.
I advance step by step.
You retreat; I advance.
I keep the shield before me.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩盾的长度。
lines.en: Only a shield's length remains.

lines.zh: 脚步声很沉，因为我是石头龙。
lines.en: Heavy steps. I'm a scaled thing of stone.
I've pressed you to the pillar.
No hurry; I outlast you.
My shield is pressed to my chest.
I sink my weight behind the shield.

lines.zh: 我从你侧面慢慢移过去。
lines.en: I shift toward your flank.
I can afford to wait.
My claws scrape the scorched earth.
Good, right here.
I raise my shield arm.
I slam in with the shield.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在你的护架上。
lines.en: My fist lands on your guard.

lines.zh: 我的盾沿砸上你的胸口。
lines.en: My shield rim slams your chest.

lines.zh: 我横过盾面挡住你的反击。
lines.en: I turn the shield against your counter.

lines.zh: 我的拳套带着火星砸下。
lines.en: My gauntlet falls with sparks.
Stone chips fly by our feet.
I follow with another blow.
My armor holds.
You're beside the broken pillar.
I raise the shield again.
Only blows sound in the fog.

lines.zh: 我用肩甲顶开你的架势。
lines.en: My pauldron breaks your guard.
I press my shield lower.
My feet are set on the stone.
My scales glow red in the hot mist.

lines.zh: 石道上多了一个甲的影子。
lines.en: An armored shadow on the stone path.
The Blazezard Knight, present.
I set my shield before me.
Light seeps through my scales.
As I settle, the fog slows.
I've surveyed this path first.
I carry no banner.

lines.zh: 我落地时石头响了一声。
lines.en: The stone rang as I landed.
I step half a pace forward.
I lift my eyes to you.
From now, you don't pass.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到我的甲，烫得很。
lines.en: Fire hits my armor and it burns hot.

lines.zh: 我从崖道摔下，甲都变形了。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff path; my armor buckles.
Water seeps into my armor; it's heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的盾震得发麻。
lines.en: The blast numbs my shield arm.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物打在我的肩甲上。
lines.en: A projectile hits my pauldron.

lines.zh: 那股力绕过我的盾，钻进骨头。
lines.en: The force skirts my shield and enters my bones.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我的力气也弱了。
lines.en: Too long hungry, and my strength fades.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的甲上，火花四溅。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my armor and sparks fly.
There's no stone path here to hold.
